definitions.explanation: An intense, persistent fear of a specific object or situation, strong enough to interfere with daily life. Used as a standalone noun and as a suffix on the feared thing.

examples.japanese: かれ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高所|こうしょ}→高所：19445_kousho⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}だ。
examples.english: He has a fear of heights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{閉所|へいしょ}→閉所：28011_heisho⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I have claustrophobia, so I'm not good with elevators.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}になった。
examples.english: Because of a childhood experience, I developed a phobia of dogs.

notes:
Most commonly used as a suffix on the feared object or situation (X{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}). A medical term that is also used loosely in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{高所|こうしょ}→高所：19445_kousho⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}: fear of heights (acrophobia)
- ⟦{閉所|へいしょ}→閉所：28011_heisho⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}: claustrophobia
- ⟦{対人|たいじん}→対人：28357_taijin⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}: social phobia
- ⟦{先端|せんたん}→先端：04370_sentan⟧{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}: fear of pointed objects

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧: fear; terror — the emotion itself, without the sense of a disorder
- ⟦トラウマ→トラウマ：17679_torauma⟧: trauma — a damaging past experience, which can be a cause of a {恐怖症|きょうふしょう}
